description: All-dimensional strict sign and high-dimensional third cumulant for the intrinsic perimeter of three random spherical vertices.
integrity: The exact analytic theorem, positive kernel derivation and reproducible numerical checker are supplied. Independently audited correctness and comprehensive historical priority have not been established.
scientific_limitations: The complete two-sphere perimeter distribution is older literature and is excluded from novelty. No closed-form all-dimensional perimeter density, uniform normal-approximation rate or complete historical priority certificate is claimed. Finite checks corroborate but do not independently validate proof.
title: Strict negative skewness and a two-term cubic law for random spherical triangle perimeters
